Surf Zone Forecast for the Mariana Islands
National Weather Service Tiyan GU
524 AM ChST Wed Nov 25 2026

.DISCUSSION...
A trade-wind swell will continue to produce elevated surf with a 
high risk of rip currents along east-facing reefs through Thursday 
afternoon. Another trade-wind surge is possible later this week, 
potentially continuing the threat of rip currents through the 
weekend. There is a moderate risk of rip currents along north-facing
reefs, and a low risk along south- and west-facing reefs.

* Low Risk of rip currents - Strong currents can still occur near
jetties and reef channels. Always have a flotation device with you
in the water.

Moderate Risk of rip currents - Wave conditions support stronger or
more frequent rip currents. Always have a flotation device with you
in the water.

High Risk of rip currents - Large waves will produce strong rip
currents, especially along narrow reefs and beaches. Rip currents
will be life threatening. If caught in a rip current, swim parallel
to the beach rather than against the current.
